name: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana
briefDescription: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY) is an accident-insurance cover of up to ₹2 lakh for bank account holders aged 18–70, for a premium of just ₹20 a year.
descriptionMd: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY) is an affordable accident-insurance scheme covering **accidental death and disability**. For a premium of just **₹20 a year**, auto-debited from your bank or post-office account on or before 1 June each year, you get one year of cover running from **1 June to 31 May**.
benefitsMd:
The cover pays out as follows:

- **Accidental death:** ₹2 lakh to the nominee.
- **Total and permanent disability** — loss of both eyes, both hands or feet, or sight of one eye plus loss of a hand or foot: **₹2 lakh**.
- **Partial permanent disability** — loss of sight of one eye, or loss of use of one hand or foot: **₹1 lakh**.
eligibilityMd:
- Individual **bank account holders aged 18 to 70** of participating banks can join by giving consent and enabling the annual auto-debit.
- The cover ends when the member turns **70**, or if the bank account is closed.
applicationMd:
PMSBY is enrolled offline:

**Step 1:** Visit the bank branch where you hold a savings account, or download the form from the official Jansuraksha portal ([jansuraksha.gov.in](https://jansuraksha.gov.in/Forms-PMSBY.aspx)).
**Step 2:** Fill in the form and submit it to the bank along with the required documents.
**Step 3:** Once enrolled, you receive an **Acknowledgement Slip Cum Certificate of Insurance**.
